card.name: Digits just after a decimal point
card.fires_on: A digit right after the decimal point in a number, usually the first decimal place such as the 0 in 4.0 or the 8 in 7.8. It appears in tables, measurements, ranges and section numbers.

modes.label: Decimal digit in measurements
modes.description: The digit after the point in a measured value or comparison.

modes.label: Numbers in tables or section numbering
modes.description: The digit after the point in table values, ranges or numbered headings.
